scope: Read-only review of the missing PS4 9.00 native bootstrap handoff. Only this report is written. No new site download, mirror, catalogue entry, bridge/UI change, console contact or payload execution.

result.recommendation: Keep the 9.00 runtime explicitly described as the initial BIN-loader stage. Link the official GoldHEN release/direct 9.00 build and provide manual bootstrap guidance. Do not claim the existing 9090/9021 sender completes the 9020 stage.
result.reason: The exact host-provided GoldHEN file has no numeric version or redistribution grant established. The archived official 2.3/9.00 file is independently identified, but exact execution compatibility with this modified runtime handoff was not confirmed. No inferred 9020 Run mapping is enabled.

transport.framing: Unframed raw bytes; end the sending side so the native read loop reaches EOF.
transport.connections: One accepted connection per loader thread; sockets are closed before invoking the receive buffer.
transport.acknowledgment: No application-success acknowledgement or HTTP status protocol.
transport.readinessProbe: Do not make an exploratory TCP connection: it can consume the single native handoff without delivering the intended payload.
transport.browserLimit: Ordinary browser JavaScript has no raw TCP API. A future paired sender route needs a dedicated fixed 9020 transport and exact approved artifact, not an HTTP request.

abi.context: x86-64 native executable-memory BIN entry; not top-level ELF, PRX/SPRX, PKG or an archive.
abi.inspection: Static reconstruction of the literal BLDR words only. The receive stub was not run.
abi.limit: The original in-page PayloadLoader and socket loader invoke an executable buffer through different native call paths. A shared .bin extension does not establish entry arguments or every build ABI.

runtime.readinessCaution: The JavaScript ready log follows thread creation; it does not independently prove a successful native bind or completed payload operation. The integration starts the AIO fetch and BIN loader without a payload-completion acknowledgement.

licensing.status: No general redistribution licence found in the existing review.
licensing.publicRoute: Use the publisher pinned official URL; preserve the existing archive-only bytes.
